title: Embedding candidate syntactic+semantic alignment gate and tenant cutover safeguard
creator: Maya Patel
description: Objective: introduce a gating and tenant-cutover framework for new embedding candidates that measures both syntactic and semantic alignment against a tenant-aware baseline before broad traffic adoption. Background: recent onboarding runs showed token-level latency regressions and sporadic semantic drift for two candidate models under high-concurrency rerank workloads. We need a reproducible safety gate that combines fast signal checks (syntactic hash overlap, top-k cosine overlap) with slower semantic probes (semantic-sanity prober, holdout similarity distributions) and enforces adaptive traffic shaping. This ticket covers infra, gating logic, rollout policy, and the tenant cutover orchestration for the first candidate model (candidates/cand-2026-03).
acceptance_criteria: Gating service implements syntactic and semantic probes and returns pass/fail + confidence score within 120ms median
Per-tenant dry-run produces a compatibility report and delta metrics (recall@k, embedding cosine shift, latency P95) for at least 50 representative tenants
Rollout controller supports traffic ramping by tenant slices, with automatic pause on SLI violations and manual override
Automated rollback triggers on sustained semantic regression (>3% drop in semantic-quality score over 1 hour) or latency SLO breach (P95 latency > 1200ms)
All new probes and metrics are visible in the embeddings console dashboard with 30d retention for the pilot
End-to-end smoke test (staging -> canary -> tenant-stage -> full) passes for cand-2026-03 with no client-facing errors and validated vector compatibility
Migration guide and per-tenant opt-out documented in Confluence and surfaced via support runbook
rollout_plan: Stage 0: Shadow evaluation on 100% of traffic to collect syntactic+semantic deltas (2 days)
Stage 1: Tenant phasing - select 10 low-risk tenants for initial live traffic (2x smaller traffic) for 24 hours
Stage 2: Widen to 30% of tenants with adaptive ramping (automated safety gates) over 48 hours
Stage 3: Open to all tenants with throttled per-tenant concurrency and KV-prefetch tuned
Stage 4: Deprecation window for old model announced and scheduled; final alias swap after 7 days of stable SLIs
telemetry_and_sli: Primary SLIs: embedding-semantic-quality (composite score), rerank-recall@10, embedding-p95-latency, per-tenant error-rate
Derived metrics: mean cosine-shift, top-k overlap ratio, kv-cache-hit-rate, batching-efficiency
Dashboards: embeddings-quality/cand-2026-03, per-tenant delta heatmap, rollout-controller-events
Alerts: SLI breach (>5% drop in composite semantic-quality) -> automatic pause + paging to on-call
compatibility_shims: Provide 2 adapter variants: float32-compatible path and quantized-8 fallback with small-scalebench
Introduce model aliasing (alias:candidate-v1) with automatic remapping to runtime variants
Add a lightweight embed-compat-prober that checks vector dimension, normalization, and past-index compatibility
rollback_plan: Automated immediate rollback on P0 SLI (latency P95 > 1200ms for 10 consecutive minutes or semantic drop > 5% for 30m)
Manual rollback via console toggle and emergency alias switch documented and tested
Post-rollback telemetry snapshot captured and incident-annotated
Fallback: route to previous stable model and enable higher batching thresholds to reduce tail latency
tests_and_smoke: Unit: gating logic (syntactic hash, cosine overlap, prober pipeline) with mocked models
Integration: staged rollout simulation harness that emulates 1000 tenants and mixed traffic patterns
E2E: staging->canary->tenant-stage pipeline with regression fences and synthetic queries
Perf: QPS ramp to 10k req/s in lab with KV cache priming and continuous batch sizing validation
